name: Schedule a meeting
definition: Enable a requester to have a meeting arranged with one or more other participants, resulting in a mutually available time being found and confirmed on the relevant calendars, or an intelligible reason why it could not be scheduled.
capabilityPurpose: Enable a meeting between people to be arranged without the requester manually coordinating availability.

includes: Determining collective availability within stated constraints
excludes: Rescheduling or canceling an existing meeting

meaningfulOutcome: A meeting is confirmed and placed on the calendars of all required participants, or the request is rejected or deferred with an identifiable reason.

interactionContracts.name: Request a meeting
interactionContracts.actor: Requester (a person, or an agent acting on a person's behalf)
interactionContracts.commandIntent: Propose a meeting with named participants within given constraints (duration, timeframe, purpose)
interactionContracts.currentState: No scheduling attempt exists for this request

policiesInvariants.text: A duration and at least one participant are required.

interactionContracts.transition: No request to pending scheduling attempt

interactionContracts.name: Resolve participant availability
interactionContracts.actor: The scheduling capability's own realization (agent or software)
interactionContracts.commandIntent: Determine which time windows are available for all required participants within the requested constraints

policiesInvariants.text: Only calendars this capability is authorized to read may be consulted.

interactionContracts.transition: Pending attempt to one or more candidate times, or a no-availability outcome
interactionContracts.result: Candidate time(s), or an identifiable no-availability reason

interactionContracts.name: Confirm meeting time
interactionContracts.actor: The requester, or an authorized participant if confirmation authority is delegated
interactionContracts.commandIntent: Select and confirm one candidate time
interactionContracts.currentState: One or more candidate times exist

policiesInvariants.text: A meeting must not be placed on a calendar this capability is not authorized to write to.

interactionContracts.result: Confirmed meeting placed on calendars, or an expiry/decline outcome

rulesInvariants.text: A meeting must not be confirmed on a calendar the capability is not authorized to write to.

recommendedDefaults.text: If no single candidate time satisfies every participant's stated constraints, surface the closest partial match rather than only reporting failure.

realizations.name: Agent-assisted scheduling assistant
realizations.rationaleIntent: Let an agent interpret intent and operate tools directly, instead of the requester manually checking calendars.

implementationRequirements.text: The agent must obtain requester (or delegated-participant) confirmation before any candidate time is written to a calendar -- the agent proposes, it does not unilaterally commit.

realizations.name: Traditional scheduling UI
realizations.rationaleIntent: A deterministic calendar-picker UI where the requester reviews availability and clicks to confirm -- no agent involved.

agenticMappings.notes: Supports Confirm meeting time; Realization A only -- Realization B writes the calendar entry directly from the UI.

provenance.text: This is an illustrative example, not extracted from a real scheduling system.
